title: Three Leafy Steps
subtitle: A Traillight adventure with Pip · ~5 min
synopsis: Pip breaks a big path into three safe leafy steps. Look first. Pick a step. Try it together. Heartlight is essence — never a separate creature.

nodes.title: Edge of the green path
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body:
Emerald Pip stands at the trailhead, Traillight glowing like a warm firefly in his acorn compass.

"Big path. Three little steps. We never rush the whole forest."

choices.label: Look first with Pip
choices.line: Look first. Pick a step. Try it together.

choices.label: Ask Nori to notice quiet details
choices.memory: Nori helped us notice soft details.

nodes.title: Map the three stones
nodes.speaker: pip
nodes.body: Pip points: "Stone one — safe. Stone two — maybe damp. Stone three — we check with a trusted adult if it feels too steep."

choices.label: Take stone one together
choices.memory: We took the first leafy step together.

choices.label: If steep, ask a trusted adult
choices.memory: We chose Safety First on the trail.

nodes.title: Quiet trail glow
nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Nori lifts Lowbeam. Tidelight makes tiny dew beads sparkle.

"The path is quieter when we pause. Notice the leaf that points the way."

nodes.title: First step glowing
nodes.speaker: pip
nodes.body: Traillight marks the stone. Pip smiles. "One step is still an adventure. The rest of the forest waits patiently."

choices.label: Ask Lumo to celebrate the co-op win

nodes.title: Party level-up
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body: Questlight flashes. "Trusted adults are the best co-op partners. That isn't quitting — it's leveling the whole party."

nodes.title: Co-op checkpoint
nodes.speaker: lumo
nodes.body: "Checkpoint saved. Player one — that's you — cleared the first leafy step. Heartlights glow as who we are, not as separate pets."

choices.label: Celebrate and rest
choices.memory: We celebrated a safe first step.

nodes.title: Traillight steady
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body: One safe step. A kinder path. Pip's Traillight is his essence — the scout in him that loves little next moves.

nodes.title: Tomorrow's leaf
nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.body: The next stone can wait. Curiosity stays soft. Traillight will be here when you are ready.
